slides.title: Your donut, your choice
slides.body: When you open the donut with a file, your own slices now come first, and Mochi's suggestions only fill the empty spots.
bullets: The tools you picked in Settings always show up when they fit the file
Anything that does not fit the front moves to the back of the donut
A donut you made for a kind of file still wins
slides.tip: Click the middle of the donut to flip it and see the back.
